log: Read 1702 Series Quad Block Motor Mount (32-2)
Claude is setting up the test

Longest extent x is the load axis, and y is taken as the stiffest transverse direction because bending in y uses the larger z depth (49.7 mm vs 26.7 mm); the part is fixed at the x-min end and loaded with 50 N transversely at the x-max end.
Final design: 11.0 g, peak 29.4 MPa, deflection 1.10x, pass
